message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles covers roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along I‑5 or US‑101. Under normal conditions—no major detours or heavy traffic—a typical trip takes around **6 hours**. In practice, rush hour congestion on the I‑5, especially near the Bay Area and the Los Angeles metro area, can add an extra hour or more, so many drivers plan for **7–8 hours** if they’re traveling during peak times.
